{{Quote|We&mdash;my team and I&mdash;were chosen to shed light on the enigma of Dagobah. It is a honor to add our discoveries to the greater knowledge of all sentient beings. The task ahead of us seems great, but we are enthusiastic and dedicated.|Halka Four-Den|<ref name="TISWU" />}}
'''Halka Four-Den''' was the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of an eight-member<ref name="TISWU" /> [[Republic Scout Service/Legends|Republic Scout Service]]<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> [[Dagobah research team|research team]] stationed on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. She kept an account of the exotic flora and fauna encountered on the distant planet, though much of it was lost. Among her discoveries were the unique [[Knobby white spider/Legends|knobby white spiders]] which later grew into the [[Gnarltree/Legends|gnarltrees]]. Halka Four-Den and her research team later disappeared there before they could be retrieved.<ref name="TISWU" />
